title: vtc-server: call-end cascades (breakout children, active recordings)
description: Oracle 1: jmap-vtc-implementer-guide.md L902-904: "When a parent call ends, all child breakout-room VTCCalls MUST also be ended (transitioning them to `\"ended\"` and setting `endedAt`)." (guide notes the draft does not state this; draft-atwood-jmap-vtc-00.md L393-397, L712-716 define parentCallId/breakoutRoomIds only). Oracle 2: jmap-vtc-recording-guide.md L322-325: "When a VTCCall transitions to `\"ended\"`, the server MUST stop all active recordings for that call. Any VTCRecording in `\"recording\"` or `\"paused\"` state is transitioned to `\"stopped\"`, with `stoppedAt` set and `VTCRecordingStateEvent` delivered." Neither cascade is named in JMAP-8mem.2 (ending a call, vtc L687-706) or JMAP-8mem.4. Source: JMAP-x3lu audit.
acceptance_criteria: Ending a parent call ends every child in breakoutRoomIds (endedAt set) before the parent; ending any call moves its recording/paused VTCRecordings to stopped with stoppedAt and reports a VTCRecordingStateEvent; tests cover moderator end and auto-end.
notes: Spec 63e9d08 changed this area after implementation; follow-up in JMAP-0x0q.34 (check what batch 7 landed before re-doing).
close_reason: Committed and adversarially verified (batch 7); CI at 84a9b7bc
